name: Craig R. Shidler
residence: Big Horn County (Lovell; Lovell Chronicle, Aug. 20, 2026)
occupation: Big Horn County sheriff-elect taking office in January 2027. The Lovell Chronicle reported that he was a Big Horn County sergeant and one of three candidates interviewed for the interim sheriff appointment in April 2026.
prior_offices: Sergeant, Big Horn County Sheriff's Office (identified as BHC Sergeant Craig Shidler in the Lovell Chronicle's April 9, 2026, report on the interim appointment)
background: Craig R. Shidler is the Big Horn County sheriff-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding interim sheriff Jason Beal. The Lovell Chronicle reported that he is of Lovell, was a Big Horn County sergeant who interviewed for the interim appointment in April 2026, and won the August 2026 Republican primary with 1,851 votes, then ran unopposed in the November general election.
